text:
lisa: Heads-up — CI is failing on kb/image-guides due to a missing image caption on the onboarding diagram. linter error shows 'image-metadata: missing caption'
kevin: which file path?
lisa: docs/kb/onboarding/infra-diagram.md
kevin: ah. that page was moved in the restructure last week, maybe frontmatter lost. can you paste the linter output?
lisa: sure — copying snippet: `Error: image-metadata: ./assets/infra-v2.png missing caption field (frontmatter)`
docs-bot: lint-runner #8245 reported failure on branch `docs/restructure` — https://ci.internal/reports/8245 :warning:
maya: I can take this if no one else is on it today. quick question: do we prefer a short caption or full credit + license in the caption?
derek: short caption in the image alt/caption and a separate LICENSES.md entry for the asset is ideal. keeps the doc tidy.
kevin: +1 to derek. caption should be 1 sentence. long-form license in LICENSES.md and link from caption like `(source)` if needed.
maya: got it. will add caption and update LICENSES.md. planning to open a tiny PR.
lisa: thanks! also pinging @sara for visibility on the onboarding guide changes :eyes:
kevin: no blocker from me — just ensure CI passes and include a brief PR description: "add caption + license entry for infra diagram"
maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/1129 — includes:
```
--- a/docs/kb/onboarding/infra-diagram.md
+++ b/docs/kb/onboarding/infra-diagram.md
@@
 - image: ./assets/infra-v2.png
+  caption: "High-level inference routing (Redwood runtime)."
```
and a new row in LICENSES.md with source + license id.
lisa: quick QA: can you also add an alt text tweak? screenreaders need it.
maya: done in the same commit — `alt: "Diagram: request routing and cache layers"`
derek: thanks. I'll review the LICENSES entry.
kevin: pinging for quick CR: @derek please, and @lisa for doc-check. if both ok we can merge and let the lint-runner re-run.
docs-bot: CI queued for PR 1129 — lint + linkcheck.
maya: small follow-up: there was also a broken internal link to `/runtime/cache#kv` I noticed while editing. I added a redirect entry in the PR to avoid a 404.
lisa: good catch. can you call out the redirect in the PR description? reviewers sometimes miss it.
maya: done. PR description updated with bullets for caption, alt, license, redirect.
derek: LGTM from me for the LICENSES row, small nit: use SPDX id `CC-BY-4.0` if that's the source, otherwise note provenance.
maya: noted — updated.
kevin: awesome. when CI passes merge it and feel free to bump the onboarding doc changelog.
lisa: thanks all. anyone want to pair to check the staging preview after merge?
maya: I can glance after merge around lunch.
kevin: I can help if something weird shows up. :thumbsup:
